one_line: Call out the exact occasion (a child starting first grade) in the first line, then hold the personalised page still.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 static wide shot: a boy about 6 to 7 bends over a black wheeled school backpack, a sun decal on the wall. Voiceover (transcript) and word-by-word subtitles: "אם גם אתן כמוני" (0:01), "שלכן", "א'" (0:03), "תישארו פה" (0:04).
q1_hook.why: The callout names a specific parent in the first second and the packed schoolbag makes the moment concrete (H1). Voice and word-by-word text start together (H6, H4). The sentence only completes at 0:04 and the book is not seen until 0:06 to 0:08, so the value is late (H2, S1).

beats.what: Boy packs the school backpack; hook subtitles "אם גם אתן כמוני" ... "א'"
beats.why: Callout plus a back-to-school scene parents recognise

beats.what: He opens the front door and holds a flat box, smiling
beats.why: Something arrives; keeps the question of what it is open

beats.what: Hands slide a book out of a box, flip other covers, then the first-grade cover; "ב MEBOOK"
beats.why: Reveal held until 0:12; other covers show each book differs

beats.what: An adult hand gives him the book; he opens it on a play-road rug
beats.why: The gift moment and his first look

beats.what: Open-mouthed reaction, then he holds the page to the camera, pointing at the cartoon boy
beats.why: The peak; the likeness is checkable in one held shot

beats.what: He reads aloud; close-up of the back cover with a round photo, QR code, MeBook.ai
beats.why: Shows the personal photo and where the book comes from

beats.what: Mother and boy read on a bed; subtitles "מוכן", "הסיפור"; he climbs off
beats.why: A warm close, but the peak has passed

beats.what: Book leaning on a pillow; blessing subtitles to "ושמח"; last 2 s without text or voice
beats.why: No new information for a buyer, no ask

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: None in the video or caption. A sendable moment exists (a gift idea for a first-grade parent, the boy pointing at himself) but nothing names a person to send it to.
q2_flow.why: "A surprise waited for him" (0:09) opens a loop that the cover reveal closes at 0:12 (H5). The reaction at 0:23 to 0:28 is a clear emotional peak in a short story (K1, K2). After it the Reel runs 23 more seconds and ends on a still (R1, R4).

q3_cta.what: None in the video: no link, comment word or ask. The last words are a blessing to new first-graders (transcript, 0:44-0:49: "תכנסו בביטחון"). Caption: no ask, only the tag @mebook.ai.
q3_cta.why: A viewer moved at 0:28 has no next step: no link, comment word or where to buy (C1, C6). The brand is said once at 0:13 and tagged in the caption, so the sell stays light (C7), at the price of any path to a purchase.

q4_shown.what: Boy at a backpack 0:00; a flat box at the door 0:06; hands slide the book out and show dinosaur, football and farm covers 0:08-0:11, then the first-grade cover with the child's name 0:12; open-mouthed reaction 0:23; page held to camera 0:26-0:28; back cover 0:32.
q4_shown.why: The book appears only at 0:08, after seven seconds of set-up (S1). The boy beside his illustrated page, held 3 s, answers the likeness doubt (S2); the voiceover names the child as hero (S8). A parent vouches in first person (S6). Face, first name and a door sign together are what LumeBook Reels avoid (S5).

q5_edit.what: 15 shots in 51.6 s, about 3.4 s each; four hard cuts in the first 9 s, a blurred cover close-up at 0:14, longest shot 7.5 s. Word-by-word subtitles, one to three words per second. Ends on a static book, last 2 s silent.
q5_edit.why: Movement from frame one and a cut every few seconds keep a steady pace (E1, E2). Synced short chunks carry the message muted (E4). The ending lingers on a still after the story has finished, with no new beat (E8, R1).

q6_topic.what: A gift for a child starting first grade: a personalised book that turns the milestone into a story to read together. Serves parents who want more than the supply list.
q6_topic.why: A named life moment and a mother as the buyer tie it to a buying moment (K7). The school-start worry and the "you are ready" line make parents feel understood (K6). The child's delighted surprise is the high-arousal feeling (K1).

q7_filmed.what: Static wide and medium shots at the door and on the bed; a low propped phone for the boy on the rug; handheld top-down close-ups of hands on a dark counter. Daylight at home, staged scenes.
q7_filmed.why: Home and daylight look native, if staged (H8, F7). Vertical and full frame (F1). Top-down hands on the covers fill the frame (F4, F5), while the wide bed shot makes the book small. Live video throughout, no stills (F8).

q8_text.on_screen: Word-by-word subtitles, bold white with a dark outline, centred about 70% down, one to three words per second, emphasis words larger: "אם גם אתן כמוני" (0:01), "א'" (0:03), "חיכתה" (0:09), "שיצרתי" (0:12), "ב MEBOOK" (0:13), "כיתה" (0:21), the child's name alone (0:37), "האלפים" (0:44), "ושמח" (0:49). No headline card.
q8_text.caption: "הפתעה קטנה לילד שלי שעולה לכיתה א׳ 🥹📚🩵". Three short lines, about 17 words: the occasion, a line with the child's name, the brand tag. No question, CTA, hashtags or disclosure words.
q8_text.why: Word-by-word subtitles let a muted viewer follow (T1) but turn the voiceover into a near transcript (T2), inside the bottom 35% (T4), with a Latin brand word inside a Hebrew line (T6). The caption's first line holds the occasion keywords (T7). Only a tag discloses the partnership (T8).

weak_points: No CTA or link; the partnership only tagged; the peak at 0:28 followed by 23 s of restating; subtitles in the bottom 35%; child's face, first name and the door's family sign together; the hook sentence completes only at 0:04.
lumebook_takeaway: Open on a hands-only school-start scene with the occasion line as text, then top-down hands hold the open page with the child's name still for 3 s.
not_verified: Whether the narrator is the mother on screen at 0:34-0:41. The full hook sentence (1 s samples miss words between 0:01 and 0:04). Whether "האלפים" is a slang for first-graders. Whether the transcript line at 0:41.7 is real room sound. Corrections to src/coded: the flat box is first seen at 0:06, the book at 0:08; the mother's face appears only 0:34-0:41. Whether the post was paid. Lead edit 18 Oct: resolution remarks removed, because the downloaded copy can be smaller than what was posted.
